title: Midgame Hazards, Labs, and Vaults
subtitle: Read the risk before the breach
summary: Toxic routes, radiation, mutation pressure, med bay recovery, labs, vaults, and data logs need clear entry, retreat, and treatment language.
body: A hazard readout should state the risk, likely countermeasure, and whether the route is safe to attempt now.
Mutation and medical UI should explain status changes before the player starts another route.
Labs and vaults should surface data-log context, route objective, loot expectations, and recovery plan before the fight.
